title: Application of the Repetitions in Reserve-Based Rating of Perceived Exertion Scale for Resistance Training
population: Practical article for coaches and athletes; no participants.
key_findings: Describes a rating of perceived exertion scale anchored to the number of repetitions left at the end of a set.
Argues it may be more precise than session or exercise RPE, lets loads be adjusted set to set to the athlete's day, and may gauge intensity better near maximal loads.
Explains how to build the scale into a training plan.
methods: Narrative practical article; it proposes and explains a method rather than testing it.
limitations: Not an outcome study: the advantages described are the authors' arguments, not measured effects.

verification.retraction_check: No retraction or correction notice in Crossref updated-by or in the PubMed publication types on 2026-11-25.
